projectDescription: A contract-first CLI that runs LLM-powered coding tasks in isolated sandboxes, validating every output against declared file contracts with deterministic checks and a QA LLM.
keyFeatures: Contract-first task execution — each task declares exactly which files the LLM may write
Git worktree sandbox — changes are isolated until QA passes, then merged
Deterministic checks — shell commands run before the QA LLM to fail fast
WHEN/THEN acceptance criteria validated by a second LLM (QA call)
Automatic failure diagnosis when a task reaches failed_permanent after 3 retries
Middleware chain enrichment — spec-gate, memory, skills, instincts, and context injected before every LLM call
Code graph with semantic embeddings for automatic context suggestion
Sub-agents — decompose a plan task into sequential sub-tasks with isolated contexts
Instincts — learned behaviors injected into prompts, approved by the human before use
Local web dashboard for runs, tasks, specs, and instincts management
Skills library — reusable prompt guidelines compiled for Claude, Cursor, and OpenAI
Model routing — route tasks to different LLM providers by task type
SQLite evidence store — every run logs tokens, cost, QA verdict, and file diffs
